arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Fitzgerald argued the automobile exception cannot override home protections.
He stated officers may not search vehicles anywhere based on probable cause alone.
Mr. Cox argued the search occurred outside the home's bright-line boundary.
He noted the officer had probable cause before entering the driveway.
